question.text: Which professionals are EXEMPT from obtaining retirement adviser registration but must still comply with general obligations?

answer.text: Advocates/solicitors/law firms, CAs, company secretaries, cost accountants, actuaries, and other PFRDA-determined professionals providing incidental retirement advice

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series XVII page 231, exempt persons include advocates, solicitors or law firms, members of ICAI (chartered accountants), ICSI (company secretaries), ICWAI (cost accountants), the Institute of Actuaries of India, and any other PFRDA-determined professional body, when retirement advice is incidental to their professional service. They must still comply with general obligations. The Trap: MF distributors, stock brokers, and insurance agents are NOT in the exempt list — they need separate registration if they want to provide retirement advice. Note: Exemption from registration does not mean exemption from the code of conduct and general responsibilities laid down by PFRDA.
